name: CULane/UE5 Synthetic Lane Dataset
description: Autonomous driving systems rely heavily on lane detection. Therefore, ensuring its robustness and reliability is crucial for road safety. This work proposes to validate one of the leading lane detection models in the CULane benchmark with an alternative synthetic dataset—with full automated ground truth labeling—from Epic Games’ Unreal Engine 5, a dynamically enriched, photorealistic simulation environment. By providing a range of diverse and challenging conditions (circadian, climatic, and road types), we aim to analyze the algorithm's performance and, in parallel, to collect reference indicators of the domain gap versus its original real-world dataset. Findings reinforce the role of synthetic data to expand testing coverage and minimize the imbalance of training datasets for safety-critical applications.
notes: Synthetic-to-real domain gap can affect comparability; benchmark is specific to lane detection and results may not transfer across datasets or simulators.
